en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing exterior and interior scenes of a historic castle complex. The upper row presents three different views of a stone castle with towers, gables and steep roofs, surrounded by trees and forested hills. The lower row shows two interior rooms furnished as a dining hall and lounge, with wooden ceilings, tables, chairs and armchairs. In the center is a black panel with German text identifying the place as Schloss Reinsberg and mentioning a holiday home of the VEB Kombinat Schwarze Pumpe.
